description: Makhana Vikas Yojana is an initiative of the Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar, to promote Makhana cultivation and improve productivity in selected districts of the state. The scheme provides training to farmers, encourages the adoption of improved cultivation practices, and offers financial assistance for purchasing traditional Makhana cultivation and processing equipment. The scheme is implemented in ten designated districts of Bihar.
objectives: Promote the cultivation of Makhana in Bihar.
Increase productivity through improved farming practices.
Provide training and technical guidance to farmers.
Support farmers with financial assistance for traditional Makhana cultivation equipment.
Enhance the income of Makhana growers.

benefits.title: Farmer Training
benefits.description: Training programmes and workshops are organized to help farmers adopt modern cultivation practices and improve productivity.

benefits.title: Equipment Grant
benefits.description: Financial assistance of 75% of the equipment cost, subject to a maximum of ₹16,575, is provided for purchasing traditional Makhana cultivation and processing tools.

benefits.title: Traditional Equipment Covered
benefits.description: The grant covers equipment such as Auka, Ganj, Kara, Khainchi, Chalni, Chatai, Afra, and Thaapi.

eligibility.title: Farmer
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a farmer.

eligibility.title: Eligible District
eligibility.description: The applicant must belong to one of the following districts: Katihar, Purnia, Darbhanga, Madhubani, Kishanganj, Supaul, Araria, Madhepura, Saharsa, or Khagaria.

eligibility.title: Land Requirement
eligibility.description: The applicant must possess agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 hectare) to a maximum of 10 acres (4 hectares).

eligibility.title: DBT Registration
eligibility.description: The applicant must be registered on the Bihar DBT portal.

eligibility.title: Ryot and Non-Ryot Farmers
eligibility.description: Ryot farmers are eligible based on land ownership documents, while non-ryot farmers must provide a valid contract form.

registration_steps.title: Visit DBT Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the Bihar DBT farmer registration portal.

registration_steps.title: Verify Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Authenticate Aadhaar using OTP, BIO-AUTH, or IRIS.

registration_steps.title: Validate OTP
registration_steps.description: Enter and verify the OTP received on the registered mobile number.

registration_steps.title: Confirm KCC Details
registration_steps.description: Verify Kisan Credit Card (KCC) details and proceed with farmer registration.

registration_steps.title: Fill Registration Form
registration_steps.description: Provide farmer details, land information, and bank account details.

registration_steps.title: Generate Registration ID
registration_steps.description: Submit the application and generate the 13-digit DBT Registration Number.

registration_steps.title: Wait for Activation
registration_steps.description: After 48 hours, use the DBT Registration Number to apply for the scheme.

application_steps.title: Proceed to Apply
application_steps.description: Scroll to the bottom, accept the declaration, and click 'Proceed to Apply'.

application_steps.title: Enter Registration Number
application_steps.description: Select the applicant type and enter the 13-digit DBT Registration Number.

application_steps.title: Fill Application Form
application_steps.description: Provide address, land details, and other required information.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Upload all the required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Accept the declaration and submit the application.

application_steps.title: Save Application Number
application_steps.description: Note the generated application number and print the application for future reference.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.remarks: Must be linked with the registered mobile number.

documents_required.name: Passport Size Photograph
documents_required.remarks: Required during DBT registration and scheme application.

documents_required.name: Land Ownership Document / Revenue Receipt
documents_required.remarks: Required for ryot farmers, if applicable.

documents_required.name: Genealogy Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Required if the applicant's name is not clearly mentioned in the land ownership or revenue receipt.

important_notes: The scheme is implemented only in ten notified districts of Bihar.
Women beneficiaries are allocated 30% participation under the scheme.
Ryot farmers must provide land ownership documents, while non-ryot farmers must submit a valid contract form.
Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis.
A valid DBT Registration Number is mandatory before applying.

faqs.question: Who can apply for Makhana Vikas Yojana?
faqs.answer: Farmers from the ten notified districts of Bihar who are registered on the DBT portal and meet the land eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: What financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: A grant covering 75% of the equipment cost, up to a maximum of ₹16,575, is provided for traditional Makhana cultivation and processing equipment.

faqs.question: Is DBT registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Farmers must complete registration on the Bihar DBT portal before applying.

faqs.question: Can non-ryot farmers apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-ryot farmers can apply by submitting a valid contract form.

faqs.question: How are beneficiaries selected?
faqs.answer: Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis.
